summary.en: The United States has revived a rarely used torture indictment against Maduro for ordering torture of rivals and has deployed Space Force electromagnetic and electronic warfare systems against Venezuela while pressuring Reliance to refine Venezuelan oil. Opposition groups are staging nationwide protests demanding elections and the return of Machado. A Dutch security report warns that Venezuela’s instability could threaten Curaçao and the wider Caribbean Kingdom. 2 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2007, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: USA har gjenopptatt en sjelden brukt torturanklage mot Maduro for å ha beordret tortur av rivaler, og har satt i drift elektromagnetiske og elektroniske krigssystemer fra Space Force mot Venezuela mens de presser Reliance til å raffinere venezuelansk olje. Opposisjonsgrupper holder landsomfattende protester som krever valg og at Machado kommer tilbake. En nederlandsk sikkerhetsrapport advarer om at Venezuelas ustabilitet kan true Curaçao og det bredere Karibiske kongeriket. To dødsfall knyttet til kamp ble registrert i 2007, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Crisis in Venezuela
background.extract: An ongoing socioeconomic and political crisis began in Venezuela during the presidencies of Hugo Chávez, Nicolás Maduro and Delcy Rodríguez. It has been marked by hyperinflation, starvation, disease, crime, and mortality rates, resulting in massive emigration. Food shortages and hyperinflation have ended, but inflation remains high. It is the worst economic crisis in Venezuela's history and considered by some sources as more severe than the Great Depression in the United States, the 1985–1994 Brazilian economic crisis, or the 2008–2009 hyperinflation in Zimbabwe. In 2019, the Institute of International Finance called it the single largest economic collapse outside of war in 45 years. Writers have compared aspects, such as unemployment and GDP contraction, to Bosnia and Herzegovina after the 1992–95 Bosnian War, and those in Russia, Cuba and Albania following the Revolutions of 1989.
